laws.rule: Port Launay and Baie Ternay Marine National Parks: SPGA requires a valid ticket for non-resident adults, retained for ranger checks. Anchor or moor only in designated areas; do not carry fishing gear or traps, fish, collect shells or coral, litter, or use motorised water sports. Overnight mooring requires a separate permit. These are marine-park rules, not a ban on fishing throughout Port Glaud district.
